استخلصن (form X)
# اِسْتَخْلَصْنَ (istaḵlaṣna) /is.tax.lasˤ.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَخْلَصَ (istaḵlaṣa)
# اُسْتُخْلِصْنَ (ustuḵliṣna) /us.tux.lisˤ.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَخْلَصَ (istaḵlaṣa)
# اِسْتَخْلِصْنَ (istaḵliṣna) /is.tax.lisˤ.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَخْلَصَ (istaḵlaṣa)
